name: Autumn Courtier
blurb: Lost of Autumn. Fear and lore, court manners, sharp contracts.
shortDesc: A thin figure in autumn colors watches from a cafe table.
description: Polite smile, cold eyes. Conversation always tilts toward what you fear most.

mask: A thin, elegant person in a charcoal suit and rust scarf.
A soft-spoken academic with leaf-brown glasses and a wool coat.
A gallery-goer type: tasteful jewelry, careful smile, eyes that measure you.
mien: Autumn leaves drift through eyes that never quite blink; skin like frost-bitten glass.
A crown of dry twigs and foxfire; breath fogs with the smell of old libraries and fear.
Too-long fingers stain the air amber; the smile is beautiful and wrong.
